content: {"praised":["Charles Laughton’s powerful Quasimodo performance","Excellent 1939 production values and visual direction","Strong musical score enhances the film’s atmosphere","Classic story remains engaging for modern viewers","Well‑crafted character portrayals, especially of Quasimodo and Esmeralda"],"criticized":["Supporting actors’ over‑the‑top performances distract from main story","Simplistic, dated Hollywood adaptation of Hugo’s novel","Some pacing issues due to excessive action scenes","Limited depth in character development beyond main roles","Story deviates from book, losing some original detail"]}
